title: Community Friend Honored at Rubaroo National Youth Leadership Conference
excerpt: Megh Foundation's Community Friend initiative received national recognition at Rubaroo's Interfaith Youth Leadership Conference in Hyderabad.
coverImageAlt: Recognition of Megh Foundation Community Friend initiative at national conference
bodyMarkdown:
## A milestone moment

Megh Foundation's **Community Friend** initiative was honored at Rubaroo's Interfaith Youth Leadership Conference in Hyderabad, recognizing sustained youth-led work in dialogue, empathy, and community inclusion.

## What Community Friend represents

Community Friend is built on one idea: young people can build stronger communities when they are trained to listen, lead, and collaborate across social and faith boundaries.

## Why this recognition is meaningful

- It validates grassroots youth leadership work
- It acknowledges difficult but necessary community dialogue
- It strengthens momentum for inclusive, interfaith civic spaces

## The road ahead

The recognition marks a deeper commitment to scale youth leadership, build more trust-based community forums, and continue creating spaces where respect and shared progress are possible.
